repository_ledger_location.designation_source: SV-LLM/.github .stegverse/transition-ledger/org-contract.json organization_ledger_ref; the same subtree layout SV-LLM/.github keeps for its own chain (repository-ledger/<repository>); StegVerse-org/.github#118 and #120
repository_ledger_location.supplied_as: SANDBOX_REPO_LEDGER_ROOT, by the SV-LLM organization workflow that runs the authentic lane
repository_ledger_location.rule: In the authentic lane the repository chain is kept in this subtree of the designated organization ledger ref and published by the organization workflow's single fast-forward push, so the next run continues from the published HEAD. Repository replay walks repository-ledger/SV-LLM/sandbox/HEAD.json back through its own receipts and never reads an organization receipt. Receipts minted before this location was bound (execution-scoped, retained in the organization ledger under source-receipts/) are history, not the head of this chain.
